note: Declared mapping rules (order 36). A work item is covered if a record names it, OR one of these rules covers it, OR NO_RECORD_NEEDED.jsonl opts it out. A rule with no reason is not applied, and the audit says so.

rules.reason: A builder run's record is its report, build_orders/reports/ORDER_<NN>_report.md, which builder_run.sh checks with reportcheck. It counts only if THIS run's RUNS line says report_exists: true and the file is there now; a run that died before writing one is not covered by a later run's report.

app.py's _log_turn appends every finished turn to memory/sessions/log.md under a '## YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' heading (local time), right after the turn's ResultMessage that writes the TURNS line. A work or sched turn with no heading within 2 minutes left no log entry.

A scheduled job is a turn whose question is the schedule's prompt, so it lands in log.md as '**You:** <prompt>' under a heading at or after last_run. 60 minutes allows for the nightly's long OpTC retry; the first 60 characters of the prompt must match, so a different turn in that hour does not count.
